de: Kaufen Sie das City Pass für freien Eintritt.
Die Kathedrale ist mittags oft ruhiger.
hu: A City Pass ingyenes belépést biztosít a legtöbb helyre.
Ne hagyja ki a helyi Cointreau likőrt.
ro: Angers este un oraș foarte prietenos cu pietonii.
City Pass oferă acces gratuit la muzee.
Catedrala este mai liberă la amiază.
en: Angers is very pedestrian-friendly and easy to navigate.
Consider a City Pass for free museum entries.
Try Cointreau, which originated in this city.
The cathedral is quieter during lunch hours.
